picks.file: Mersina. Mersina from the sea LOC matpc.02199.jpg
picks.what: The town from the sea, photograph (Matson Collection, Library of Congress)
picks.why: only true view of the old port town: waterfront with boats; trimmed to the left half of the stereo pair

gaps: P0–P3: nothing usable (a fish book page and a sea chart); P5: only undated copies of the same sea view and a 1919 troop parade; P6: only churches and a castle elsewhere in the province
notes: #3 is modest: the town is a low band on the horizon, no landmarks, but it is clearly labeled Mersina and is the only real general view. #8 is a wider, larger shot of the same view but LOC dates it only 1898–1946, so not used. #9 (Gadmer autochrome, 10 December 1919, troops lined up for General Gouraud’s arrival) is a color street scene but dominated by soldiers; skipped, could serve as a P5 event view if the reviewer wants one.
